nodes.description: Constant uint256 storage slot holding the address of the logic (implementation) contract, keccak256("PROXIABLE").
Constructor that validates the logic address (non-zero) and stores it into PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT via inline assembly sstore.
Payable fallback that loads the logic address from storage and delegatecalls it with the full incoming calldata, forwarding return data or reverting.
Inline-assembly delegatecall to the stored logic address; executes arbitrary external code in the context of this proxy's storage.
Inline-assembly sstore writing contractLogic into PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT; the only state-mutating write in the contract.
Address parameter of the constructor representing the logic contract to be registered.
Assembly local holding the logic address loaded from PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT inside the fallback.
Assembly local memory pointer taken from the free memory pointer (0x40) used for calldata copy and return data copy.
Assembly local storing the boolean result of the delegatecall.
Assembly local storing the size of the return data produced by the delegatecall.

edges.reason: The constructor body executes the inline-assembly sstore that persists the logic address.
The constructor parameter contractLogic is written into storage by the sstore operation.
PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT is the storage key used as the sstore destination.
The fallback function body reaches the delegatecall assembly block.
PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT is sloaded into the fallback's local contractLogic variable.
The logic address local is the target of the delegatecall.
The memory pointer holding calldata is passed as input to the delegatecall.
The delegatecall result is captured in the success local variable.
The delegatecall return data size is captured in the retSz local variable.
delegatecall executes arbitrary logic-contract code in this proxy's storage context, which can re-enter the fallback (possibly while state is mid-update).

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter contractLogic is only used as the value written by the sstore operation, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
The fallback's local contractLogic only feeds the delegatecall target, so it folds into the delegatecall node.
The assembly memory pointer local exists only as delegatecall input, so it folds into the delegatecall node.
The success local only records the delegatecall outcome, so it folds into the delegatecall node.
The retSz local only records the delegatecall return data size, so it folds into the delegatecall node.
